Among Terminal 0.1.1 improves everyday terminal workflows and sidebar controls.

- New split terminals inherit the current directory of the pane they came from.
- Touchpad scrolling follows gesture distance; mouse-wheel scrolling keeps its
  existing behavior.
- Rename a workspace by double-clicking its name, without opening an editor when
  you only want to switch workspaces.
- Drag the expanded sidebar's right edge to resize it. The chosen width returns
  after collapse/expand and after restarting the application.
- Bottom pop-up messages are removed. Errors remain in stderr and existing
  persistent Settings warnings; explicit plugin status content remains visible.

See the [feature guide](https://github.com/Among-Terminal/among/blob/v0.1.1/docs/features.md)
for the available controls and demonstrations.
